Kagan and Soai Awarded Nobel Prize in Chemistry

Henri Kagan and Kenso Soai have been awarded the 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for their work in asymmetric organic synthesis, which solved a century-old molecular mystery. Kagan is affiliated with Université Paris-Sud in Orsay, France, and Soai, aged 95, is affiliated with the Tokyo University of Science.
